generate_idl_iids(qmgr_local.idl)
spec2def(qmgr.dll qmgr.spec)

add_idl_headers(qmgr_idlheader qmgr_local.idl)

# qmgr.dll is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/qmgr-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# How cmake compiled the target's sources, now on the OBJECT libraries.
# Generated inputs those compiles read, ordered before them.
add_library(qmgr_shims OBJECT enum_files.c enum_jobs.c factory.c file.c job.c qmgr.c service.c ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/qmgr_local_i.c)
target_link_libraries(qmgr_shims PRIVATE uuid wine wine_dll_register wine_dll_canunload oldnames libwinhttp libole32 libadvapi32 libmsvcrt libkernel32 libkernel32_vista libntdll)
set_wine_module_fixme(qmgr_shims)
add_dependencies(qmgr_shims qmgr_idlheader)
add_cargo_module(qmgr qmgr-cargo qmgr.dll
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS qmgr_shims psdk uuid_sources)
